description: SvAccordion in Svelte 5: collapsible sections with single or multiple expand through expandMode, roving header focus with Up, Down, Home and End, and full WAI-ARIA with region roles and aria-controls. The panel body is a snippet that receives the item, expanded ids are controlled through expanded and onChange, and dir='rtl' mirrors the chevron and layout.

faq.question: How do I allow only one open section?
faq.answer: Set expandMode='single'. Opening a section closes the others; 'multiple' lets any number stay open, and expanded holds the open ids either way.

faq.question: How do I render custom content in a panel?
faq.answer: Pass a snippet as the accordion's body; it receives the item so one template renders every section, or the items can carry their own content.

faq.question: Which keys move between headers?
faq.answer: Up and Down move to the previous and next header, Home and End jump to the first and last, and Enter or Space toggles the focused section.
